verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions outside counsel, law-firm roles, or external advisers who can prepare documents and update records inside Vestd. Data-room access controls ('who gets access'), 'Invite your team' and custom document templates are adjacent features. None of them shows a law-firm role with editing rights, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, my outside counsel can work directly in the platform with law-firm roles — preparing documents and updating records without emailing spreadsheets
